own_consequence_statement: For the exact applied domain, the unregularized psh envelope of a pulled-back continuous obstacle commutes with scalar extension: P_F(phi_F)=P_K(phi) composed with pi, pointwise at every point of X_F^an. Here P is the pointwise supremum over the BE decreasing-FS-net psh cone; no assertion that this envelope is continuous/usc/psh in general is inserted.
own_consequence_proof: Clear rational denominators and let m tend to infinity through the semigroup N(L) of globally generated powers. Flat field base change identifies H0(X,mL) tensor F with H0(X_F,mL_F). Let a_m be the supnorm of m phi over K, and b_m the supnorm of m phi_F over F.

BE Theorem6.6, using geometric reducedness and continuity, gives d_infinity(b_m,(a_m)_F)=o(m). Exact equality of these norms is not assumed; Lemma6.2 has additional finite-tame-Galois/discrete hypotheses which are not imposed here.

The definitional FS norm estimate (7.1) gives sup absolute value of FS(b_m)-FS((a_m)_F) at most their d_infinity distance. Lemma7.20 identifies FS((a_m)_F) with the pullback of FS(a_m). Division by m therefore gives a uniformly vanishing difference on X_F^an.

The full Theorem7.26 gives pointwise limits m^-1 FS(a_m) -> Q_K(phi) and m^-1 FS(b_m) -> Q_F(phi_F), where Q is the FS envelope. At each upstairs point the normalized uniform error tends to zero, so Q_F(phi_F)=Q_K(phi) composed with pi. No integration of an arbitrary measurable net occurs.

For continuous phi, Proposition7.25 identifies Q_K(phi)=P_K(phi) and Q_F(phi_F)=P_F(phi_F). Its direct argument uses a decreasing FS net psi_i to an arbitrary dominated psh psi, compactness and lsc(phi-psi_i) to put psi_i below phi+epsilon on a tail. The printed psi_i -> phi in that source proof is read as the defining approximation psi_i -> psi. This yields the claimed pointwise identity without any EP grant.

If P_K(phi) is continuous, its pullback is continuous and the identity gives continuity of this particular upstairs pulled-back obstacle envelope. This does not prove EP for arbitrary upstairs obstacles. Conversely, continuity of this particular upstairs envelope descends through the standard compact-Hausdorff surjective analytic field projection, which is a quotient map. This last statement uses the usual analytic projection background, not a new singular-metric descent theorem.
continuous_measure_energy_application: Proposition8.3(iv) and uniform-to-weak extension8.4 give pi_* MA_F(pulled continuous psh slots)=MA_K(original slots), with unchanged geometric raw mass. The ordinary single-measure pushforward integration law then gives equality of relative continuous mixed energy expressions. No field-degree multiplier is introduced for scalar base change.
limits: No continuity of arbitrary envelopes over a nondiscrete field is proved; source Theorem7.31 recognizes continuous pulled-back psh metrics, not all singular/E1 metrics.
A scalar extension of a field with dense value group cannot make that embedded value group discrete. Reducing arbitrary complete K to a discretely valued extension by name substitution is invalid.

No normalized singular potential compactness, genuine full E1 mixed/unbounded products, comparison, unbounded first variation, original variational attainment or every-solution uniqueness is constructed here.

The algebraically closed trivially valued originalP16.5 grant does not apply after extending a nontrivially valued ground field. The scalar envelope identity cannot remove this valuation-domain restriction.
